# Down South Land Solutions

> Land clearing, forestry mulching and excavating contractor based in
> Berry, AL, working eight counties across West Alabama.
> Free estimates, priced after looking at the property.

Down South Land Solutions runs its own dozers, compact track loaders with FAE mulching heads,
and excavators. Work ranges from forestry mulching and land clearing through
house pads, driveways, culverts, drainage, tree removal, demolition and
finish grading. Phone and text: (205) 535-6376.

## Services
- [Forestry Mulching](https://dsland.solutions/forestry-mulching/): One machine, one pass. Standing brush, briars, saplings and small timber go into the head and come out as mulch on the ground — no piles to burn,
- [Land Clearing](https://dsland.solutions/land-clearing/): When it's bigger than a mulcher can take, the dozer goes to work. Trees pushed, roots raked out, debris windrowed and burned or hauled depending on
- [Tree Removal](https://dsland.solutions/tree-removal/): Dead, leaning, crowded or storm-damaged trees taken down and cleaned up. We work with machines on open ground, so if there's room to get to it,
- [Excavating](https://dsland.solutions/excavating/): Footings, trenching, culvert sets, stump and root removal, and the jobs that just need a machine on site and somebody who knows how to run
- [Site Work](https://dsland.solutions/site-work/): Access cut in, culverts set, ditching and drainage run so water goes where you want it, laydown areas built, spoil moved and spread. The work nobody
- [House Demolition](https://dsland.solutions/house-demolition/): Old houses, mobile homes, barns and outbuildings taken down and cleaned up — slab broken out, footprint backfilled and graded, and the lot left so
- [Retaining Walls](https://dsland.solutions/retaining-walls/): Block and boulder walls to hold a cut, flatten a yard that never was flat, or keep a bank out of the driveway every time it rains
- [House Pads](https://dsland.solutions/house-pads/): Cut, filled and compacted to grade so your slab crew shows up to something they can work on instead of something they have to fix
- [Underbrush Removal](https://dsland.solutions/underbrush-removal/): Take the junk out and leave the timber standing. Privet, briars, greenbrier, kudzu, honeysuckle and sapling growth cleared out from under trees you
- [Hunting Lanes & Food Plots](https://dsland.solutions/hunting-lanes-food-plots/): Shooting lanes cut, trails opened, food plots cleared and the ground left ready to disc and plant. Hunting land work, done by somebody who
- [Pasture Reclamation](https://dsland.solutions/pasture-reclamation/): Fields that have grown up in sweetgum, briars and privet, brought back to ground you can run cattle on or cut hay off
- [Fence Line Clearing](https://dsland.solutions/fence-line-clearing/): Fence lines, survey lines and rights of way cut straight, clean and wide enough to actually work
- [Firebreaks](https://dsland.solutions/firebreaks/): Breaks cut around homes, shops, timber stands and property lines — before you need them, not
- [Driveways & Access Roads](https://dsland.solutions/driveways/): Drives and access roads cut in, based, crowned and ditched so the water leaves instead of running down the middle of

## Service area
Eight counties in West Alabama, out of Berry in Fayette County.
- [Fayette County](https://dsland.solutions/land-clearing-fayette-county-al/)
- [Walker County](https://dsland.solutions/land-clearing-walker-county-al/)

## Notes
- We do not publish per-acre prices. Cost depends on what is standing, the
  terrain, access and what you want left behind, so every job is quoted after
  the property is looked at.
- Forestry mulching leaves ground cover and does not remove stumps. Land
  clearing removes stumps and root balls and leaves buildable ground.
- Tree work is machine work from the ground. We are not a climbing crew.
